_comment: Reviewed high/critical advisories that are accepted until the tracked major upgrade (astro 7, @astrojs/vercel 11, sharp 0.35, @vercel/blob 2). Every entry needs a reason. Remove entries as upgrades land; scripts/ci/audit-deps.mjs reports stale ones.

advisories.title: Astro: Remote code execution through AVIF image optimization
advisories.reason: Fixed only in astro 7 (major). Advisories reviewed 2026-07: the vulnerable patterns (define:vars, spread props on elements, dynamic slot names) are not used in this codebase.

advisories.title: Astro: Host header SSRF in prerendered error page fetch
advisories.reason: Fixed only in astro 7 (major). Advisories reviewed 2026-07: the vulnerable patterns (define:vars, spread props on elements, dynamic slot names) are not used in this codebase.

advisories.title: Astro: Reflected XSS via unescaped slot name
advisories.reason: Fixed only in astro 7 (major). Advisories reviewed 2026-07: the vulnerable patterns (define:vars, spread props on elements, dynamic slot names) are not used in this codebase.

advisories.title: sharp inherited vulnerabilities in libvips: CVE-2026-33327, CVE-2026-33328, CVE-2026-35590, CVE-2026-35591
advisories.reason: Fixed in sharp 0.35 (major). sharp is only run by local build scripts on trusted, client-supplied images; never on user uploads.

advisories.title: sharp: Vulnerabilities in libheif: GHSA-g89c-p67h-r497 and GHSA-2jg2-4ch7-h545
advisories.reason: Fixed in sharp 0.35 (major). sharp is only run by local build scripts on trusted, client-supplied images; never on user uploads.

advisories.title: Undici has Unhandled Exception in WebSocket Client Due to Invalid server_max_window_bits Validation
advisories.reason: Transitive via @vercel/blob; fixed only by @vercel/blob 2 (major), which changes the upload API used by src/pages/api/content/posts/upload.ts.

advisories.title: Undici has Unbounded Memory Consumption in WebSocket permessage-deflate Decompression
advisories.reason: Transitive via @vercel/blob; fixed only by @vercel/blob 2 (major), which changes the upload API used by src/pages/api/content/posts/upload.ts.

advisories.title: undici WebSocket client vulnerable to denial of service via fragment count bypass
advisories.reason: Transitive via @vercel/blob; fixed only by @vercel/blob 2 (major), which changes the upload API used by src/pages/api/content/posts/upload.ts.
